name: nx-kv
description: nx-kv — 本机任务队列（localtask）+ 文档库 + 仓库登记：serve 驱动 CLI 与 Web 面板，同源同构，附带可安装 skill 供 agent 提交 / 领取 / 阻塞接收任务

scripts.gen: pnpm run gen:actions && pnpm run gen:api && pnpm run gen:plugins
scripts.build:packages: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run build:plugins
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run gen && pnpm run build:packages && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json tsconfig.web.json
scripts.build: pnpm run gen && pnpm run build:packages && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json && vite build && node scripts/link-local.mjs --auto
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && node --import tsx scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.dev:serve: pnpm run build:packages && node --import tsx src/runtime/cli.ts serve --no-open
scripts.start: pnpm run build && node --import tsx src/runtime/cli.ts serve
scripts.lint: eslint . && node scripts/check-tdz.mjs --all && node scripts/check-schema-decisions.mjs && node scripts/check-lines.mjs && node scripts/check-skill-sop.mjs && node scripts/check-test-isolation.mjs && node scripts/check-service-calls.mjs && node scripts/check-plugin-isolation.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run test:unit
